name: Octatrack
summary: Effects, machines, MIDI and USB modules built on octabam.

firmware.flash: Copy the .bin to the card root, then PROJECT › SYSTEM › OS UPGRADE.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, choose MIDI UPGRADE and send the stock .syx over DIN MIDI.

sdk.toolchain: GNU binutils 2.47 (m68k-elf) and the dsp56300 assembler, run in the pinned build container (sdk/build/Dockerfile).

budgets.name: Reserved module memory
budgets.note: The bottom 1,707 pages (6,144 B each) of the audio page arena that the octabam platform reserves for modules.

name: Digitakt
summary: New SRC machines, a slice editor and system diagnostics.

firmware.flash: Send the .syx with Elektron Transfer and confirm on the unit.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, choose OS UPGRADE and send the stock .syx.

research.label: elekloader
research.note: Device profile, OS file writer and a core with shared hooks, verified in an emulator and on units by the mods’ authors.

research.label: elektron-firmware-tool
research.note: First public documentation of the OS container, SysEx transport and packing.

sdk.toolchain: m68k-elf GCC and binutils for ColdFire, and Modwerk’s .elemod linker and OS writer (in development).

budgets.name: Shared mod memory
budgets.note: DDR 0x47BE0000–0x47C00000 below the audio DMA ring, shared by the core and every mod (public research: elekloader, digikit).

budgets.name: Fast SRAM for code
budgets.note: On-chip SRAM tail 0x8000F700–0x80010000 for time-critical code.

budgets.name: SRC machine slots
budgets.note: Machine ids 4–7, added by the core for new SRC machines.

name: Digitone
summary: Parameter slots, mod pages, project data and a Mod Menu for FM mods.

firmware.flash: Send the .syx with Elektron Transfer and confirm on the unit.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, choose OS UPGRADE and send the stock .syx.

research.label: elekloader
research.note: Device profile, OS file writer and a core with shared hooks, verified in an emulator and on units by the mods’ authors.

sdk.toolchain: m68k-elf GCC and binutils for ColdFire, and Modwerk’s .elemod linker and OS writer (in development).

budgets.name: Shared mod memory
budgets.note: DDR 0x47BE0000–0x47C00000 below the audio DMA ring, shared by the core and every mod (public research: elekloader, digikit).

budgets.name: Parameter slots
budgets.note: Parameter ids 182–184, handled by the stock UI with knobs, values and p-locks.

budgets.name: Mod pages
budgets.note: Pages 27–30, each placed after a stock page in its key’s list.

name: Digitakt II
summary: OS 1.17 support and Perform Direct are in review. Verify your original OS file locally; builds will follow after qualification.

firmware.flash: The author reports an in-OS upgrade with Elektron Transfer over USB. Modwerk builds remain pending qualification.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, press TRIG 4 for OS UPGRADE, and send the original .syx over MIDI ports, not USB.

research.label: elekloader — Digitakt II support by toonst
research.note: OS 1.17 sealed writer, exact stock rebuild and core hooks; emulator checks and a Perform Direct hardware build reported upstream. These are author reports, not Modwerk qualification.

research.label: digikit
research.note: Emulator for the control processor that boots the real OS and shows its screen, plus analysis tools for the audio processor and the sealed OS file.

sdk.toolchain: m68k-elf GCC and binutils for ColdFire, with the pinned elekloader builder in a local sandbox. Pending source is excluded from CI.

budgets.name: Shared mod memory
budgets.note: Upstream DDR 0x47F00000–0x47F40000, shared by core and mods; qualification remains pending.

budgets.name: Fast SRAM for code
budgets.note: Upstream SRAM tail 0x8000F100–0x80010000; copied by core on the first ev_tick. Key/encoder handlers must remain in DDR.

summary: Shares the Digitakt II platform and its sealed OS file.
